areaName: Night of the Restless Dead Main Area
areaDescription: Imported adventure: Night of the Restless Dead

locations.name: Ma's Watering Hole
locations.description: The party arrives at Ma's Watering Hole, a rural inn between Yatar and Waterdeep. Ma runs the inn and Blarg, a large half-orc, handles security.
locations.creatures: Ma (commoner), Blarg (berserker), Crawling Claw, Zombie, Zombie.

investigation_hooks.description: Ma flinches when cathedral cult is mentioned; she knows more than she admits
investigation_hooks.reward: Hidden cellar passage to Priest's Lodging (bypass the main hall and storage)
investigation_hooks.cross_module_ref: Mayor Tilda Bramble (Pumpkin King) mentions 'my sister who fled'

investigation_hooks.description: Letters from Greenfields Vale demanding reports on cathedral activity
investigation_hooks.reward: Blarg is Pumpkin King spy; can be blackmailed for cathedral layout
investigation_hooks.consequence: If discovered, Blarg offers intel to save his life

npcs.name: Ma (Margaret Thornfield)
npcs.description: A kind innkeeper masking deep fear of the cathedral cult and the Bramble bloodline.

npcs.name: Blarg
npcs.description: A broad half-orc bouncer who watches newcomers closely and knows more about the cathedral than he admits.

locations.name: Brother Lintar's Place
locations.description: A lamplit stone refuge on the outskirts between Ma's inn and the ruined cathedral. Brother Lintar keeps a small chapel here, with clean cots, bread ovens, and a stout door that can be barred against the dead.

npcs.name: Brother Lintar
npcs.description: A warm half-elf priest and keeper of a modest refuge on the village outskirts, ready to shelter the weary and guard Saint Rydal's relic.

investigation_hooks.trigger: Automatic on arrival with the relic or Father Aldric
investigation_hooks.description: Brother Lintar recognizes Saint Rydal's relic and offers sanctuary, food, and a defensible place to regroup before the party returns to the cathedral.
investigation_hooks.reward: Safe rest staging point and local lore about the village outskirts and the cathedral road

locations.name: Ruined Cathedral Main Hall
locations.description: The party reaches the ruined cathedral. Thick webs cover the entrance and the main hall is dark and damaged.

investigation_hooks.description: Altar defaced with Pumpkin King sigils; inscription mentions 'The First Keeper'
investigation_hooks.reward: Lore connecting to Pumpkin King's First Tithe
investigation_hooks.cross_module_ref: Matches inscription at Churchyard Shrine (Pumpkin King VO001)

investigation_hooks.description: Tithe payment log beneath loose altar stone: 1847, 1892, 1947, 2002, 2017
investigation_hooks.reward: Reveals Bramble family payments; cult has operated for 170+ years

locations.environmental_storytelling: Echoing ritual chanting from below suggests living occupants

locations.name: Cathedral Storage
locations.description: The storage room is mostly empty except for old barrels and dried blood. A web-wrapped figure hangs from the ceiling.

investigation_hooks.description: Web-wrapped inquisitor from Waterdeep paralyzed but alive; Medicine DC 15 to save

choices.save: Inquisitor provides official sanction; opens Waterdeep ending path
choices.ignore: Victim dies after 24 hours; body looted by cultists

locations.name: Priest's Lodging
locations.description: An old bed frame, fireplace, and a cellar door are in this room. Faint light shows through the cellar door edges. This chamber is beneath the ruined cathedral, and the hidden bypass from Ma's inn links here before continuing deeper into the catacombs.

investigation_hooks.trigger: Perception DC 12 or if inquisitor saved in NIG03
investigation_hooks.description: Father Aldric hides behind fireplace, fears cult will find him
investigation_hooks.reward: Reveals cathedral built over druid circle; shows druid carvings

choices.help_escape: Guides party to side path; Third Path ending unlocked
choices.ignore: Face harder ritual combat; no Third Path without Thornwood artifacts
choices.kill: If suspected cultist; lose druid revelation entirely

investigation_hooks.trigger: Father Aldric reveals or Investigation DC 18
investigation_hooks.description: Druid carvings behind fireplace show original pact agreement
investigation_hooks.reward: Reveals Third Path: druid circle can absorb curse without sacrifices
investigation_hooks.cross_module_ref: Corrupted druids in Thornwood (NCW001) are same circle

npcs.name: Father Aldric
npcs.description: A frightened priest hiding behind the fireplace, desperate to save the cathedral's true ward.

locations.name: Cellar Hallway
locations.description:
A collapsed branching tunnel leads to a single large door with light leaking through. If the alarm was triggered, enemies prepare an ambush.

**Exits:**
- South: Priest's Lodging
- North: Dead End Ritual Chamber

locations.name: Dead End Ritual Chamber
locations.description: A cultist and Red argue about acquiring more experiments for a necromantic ring. They attack when alerted.

climax_scene.faction_conflict: Miriam (cult leader) vs Red (Pumpkin King enforcer)
dialog: Miriam: 'We fled Greenfields Vale to break this curse! Sacrifices are necessary!'
Red: 'The Pumpkin King demands tribute. Surrender the ring or face His wrath.'

moral_grayness_signals.cult_harm: Captive villagers in experimentation cells; notes on unwilling subjects
moral_grayness_signals.cult_motive: Bramble family refugees fleeing tithe; notes on curse reversal attempts
moral_grayness_signals.cult_desperation: Multiple failed ritual attempts documented; running out of time

aid_cult.consequence: Miriam teaches curse-breaking method; ring fragment absorbed; cultists scatter
aid_cult.cross_module_impact: Pumpkin King NPCs hostile in future encounters; Ma flees to warn King

oppose_cult.consequence: Cult destroyed; Red rewards with gold; cult reforms elsewhere
oppose_cult.cross_module_impact: Miriam's ghost haunts later areas; cultists appear as undead
oppose_cult.ring_status: Ring kept by Red; Pumpkin King pleased

negotiate.description: Third Path: negotiate with druid circle
negotiate.prerequisite: Father Aldric's lore OR druid artifacts from Thornwood
negotiate.consequence: Druid circle absorbs curse; no sacrifices needed; both factions leave
negotiate.cross_module_impact: Minimal impact; optional druid spirit ally in future

kill_both.consequence: Cult broken, Pumpkin King angry, both rings lootable
kill_both.cross_module_impact: Both factions hunt party in other modules

npcs.name: Sister Miriam Bramble
npcs.description: A desperate cult leader trying to break the tithe curse through forbidden necromancy.

npcs.name: Red (The Crimson Binder)
npcs.description: A crimson-robed enforcer of the Pumpkin King demanding the ring and the cult's submission.

locations.name: Conclusion
locations.description:
The party returns to Ma's Watering Hole after ending the immediate threat. They receive lodging and reward, but larger cult activity may continue.

**Exits:**
- None

tithe_paid.description: Ma reveals Pumpkin King loyalty; Blarg reports party as 'proven worthy'
tithe_paid.cross_module_hook: Pumpkin King agents approach party in Thornwood or Greenfields

pact_broken.description: Ma horrified, flees to warn Pumpkin King; party becomes enemies of the tithe
pact_broken.cross_module_hook: Pumpkin King NPCs mention 'traitors who broke the circle'

waterdeep_conspiracy.trigger: Save inquisitor in NIG03 and choose lawful resolution
waterdeep_conspiracy.description: Inquisitor arrests everyone legally; cult disbanded, Miriam imprisoned
waterdeep_conspiracy.cross_module_hook: Waterdeep bounty notices appear in future modules

druid_circle.description: Druid spirits absorb curse; cathedral consecrated; no ongoing threat
druid_circle.cross_module_hook: Optional druid ally appears in Thornwood Watch
